name: Floaty Fall
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user of this Movve is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: With the help of 99 air balloons, the user jumps up high and falls on top of its foe. The use of 99 balloons in-battle is questionable, but the referee will allow them.
